description: One visit in full: the story of each page load, every moment Cromanion's agent looked at the visitor and what it decided, what the visitor actually saw, and the doubts it read. Pass the `visitId` from cromanion_visits, or a `sessionId` from cromanion_live once that visitor has left. Needs the visits permission. Readings sit under `reading`; a moment at or after the conversion carries `observed` instead, because the conversion is a fact. `shown.seen` is what the visitor's browser confirmed, not what was sent. Same 60-an-hour budget as cromanion_visits.

sessionId.description: Instead of visitId: any session of the visit, e.g. one seen in cromanion_live.

siteId.description: Which site this call is about. Only needed when your credential covers more than one — cromanion_grants lists them and says whether it is required. Omitting it with several is refused rather than guessed at.

name: cromanion_visit

visit.description: Everything in a cromanion_visits row, plus `narrative` (one entry per session: startedAt, flushed, text — empty while not yet flushed), `moments` (at, path, kind, trigger, outcome, shown, reading | observed) and `truncated` when only the newest 30 sessions are returned.
